name: controlled-authored-bilingual-memory-v1
scope: Small authored corpus and binary judgments; not sampled live user traffic and not an independent quality study. Input order represents the existing ledger's newest-first order. All judgments were frozen before implementing or measuring the candidate.
judgmentRule: Relevant IDs identify records directly addressing the stated query intent. Empty lists mean no relevant record. Every returned ID outside the list is irrelevant for this controlled corpus.
